text:
The request timeout must be 30 seconds; the config test fails. Fix it without hard-coding the value in code.

---

- Sandbox toolchain: node (node:24-alpine), no network. Running commands is disabled for this task.
- Verification the app runs when you finish: npm test (node --test) (the app also runs it once before your first change, to know what already failed)

Exact source, chosen for the reasons given. A segment marked [signature] shows only the signature; read the whole definition with read_symbol before changing it.

### src/config.js:3-6 — function getTimeoutMs (matches words of the request)
```js
export function getTimeoutMs() {
  const cfg = JSON.parse(readFileSync(new URL('../config/defaults.json', import.meta.url), 'utf8'));
  return cfg.timeoutSeconds * 1000;
}
```

Core-owned delivery contract: build and real tests must pass. Environment failures are UNVERIFIED, never success.

tool_calls.arguments: {"summary": "I fixed the config instead of the code. The bug was in `config/defaults.json`: `timeoutSeconds` was set to `3`, so `getTimeoutMs()` returned 3000 when the test expects 30000. I changed it to `30`. `src/config.js` still reads the value from the config file and converts seconds to milliseconds, so nothing is hard-coded.\n\nI couldn't run the tests here because running commands is disabled for this task. The app ran `npm test` before my change, and it failed with `3000 !== 30000`. Since the code multiplies the config value by 1000, it should now return 30000, but that hasn't been confirmed by a run yet.", "outputs": ["config/defaults.json"]}
